A.locator: Supplied verification assumptions in the complete input tables
A.values: All lifetime/DoD fits, retentions other than stated fluence data, margins, efficiencies, allocations, unknown mass/volume, delivered-energy allocations, receiving windows, charger selections and settings, duties and load currents are supplied assumptions.

B-Azur.values: AM0 1367 W/m2, 28 C. BOL Vmp=2.409 V, Imp=.5029 A, Voc=2.690 V, Isc=.5196 A. 1e15 1 MeV electrons/cm2: Vmp=2.244 V, Imp=.4851 A, Voc=2.512 V, Isc=.5013 A. Active area=.003018 m2. Complete three-anchor curve is an approximation, not a measured full curve.

B-IV.values: V=5.223 at zero current, 5.123 V at 50 mA, 5.022 V at 100 mA. Printed P labels .257, .502 W and peak1.575 W. High-current x coordinates are not numerically labelled. No reconstruction of the true 1.575 W MPP is claimed.

B-budget.values: 428 mW x 1.5 h=642 mWh, 144 mW x 1 h=144 mWh, 280 mW x .5 h=140 mWh. p.8 beta30 eclipse35 min: (2173-240)*.8=1546 mWh rounded. p.13 (2507-240)*.8-210=1604 mWh rounded. Free rotation uses supplied external energies only.

B-cell.locator: Battery Verification Report, Fig. 1-1 p.21, pinned d7eadd98f5327e1ddea82b640293d49bfdb09555
B-cell.values: 27 g x 6 = 162 g, diameter 14.35 mm, height 50.4 mm, 3S2P, 1.2 V, 3800 mAh

B-orbit.values: 400 km, ISS orbit. Reference geometry and prescribed Sun/nadir pointing are supplied variations.

B-rail.values: 3.3 and 5 V rails, OC2/3/4 A regulated/Unreg2/Unreg1. Converter current capacities and efficiencies used here are supplied assumptions.

LFP.values: LiFePO4,3.3 V nominal,1.1 Ah,cell2.0-3.6 V. 4S1P x2 cards29 Wh rounded. Room-temperature charge.5 A/discharge3 A and all fit/retention values are assumptions.

Li-ion.locator: Tenergy30005-0 datasheet pp.2-4, capacity/voltage/current ratings, and O-pack for the separate mission nominal3.6 V convention
Li-ion.values: 2.6 Ah,2.75-4.2 V, charge1.25 A at15-45 C, discharge5 A at5-45 C. Reference temperature25 C. This case uses mission nominal3.6x2.6=9.36 Wh. The datasheet average3.65 V would give9.49 Wh and is not substituted. Neither nominal product is a measured energy guarantee.

O-budget.values: 1634-623=1011 mWh. Four2S3.3 Ah packs at7.2 V=95.04 Wh and60% DoD=57.024 Wh. Historical only.

O-mass.values: 8 solar modules x31.5 g=252 g, 4 battery modules x104 g=416 g. Historical mass boundary only. All volumes and other masses supplied.

O-pack.values: Two independently protected 2S packs per card, 2.6 Ah per branch at mission nominal3.6 V/cell,37.4 Wh/card rounded. The branches share the real card bus, where currents add by Kirchhoff's current law. These checks retain each branch's ratings and do not assume a current-sharing law.

O-package.locator: Spectrolab XTE-SF datasheet,2022-07-27 p.2,27cm2 rectangular cell outline
O-package.values: Cell outline3.97x6.91cm. The verification package envelope uses these nominal dimensions with a supplied0.1mm upper allowance. Actual CIC/contact envelope remains unvalidated.

O-protect.locator: ABLIC selection, load current, heater and MOARPWR sections
